description_en: Queries the default data classification template defined by Data Security Guard
description_zh: 调用QueryDefaultTemplate接口查询数据保护伞定义的默认分类分级模板
name: QueryDefaultTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the DataStudio page, click your username in the upper-right corner, and choose Menu > User Info to obtain the tenant ID.

You can also obtain the tenant ID from Data.TenantId in the response of the GetProject operation
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID。

也可通过 GetProject 响应中的 Data.TenantId 获取
parameters.name: tenant_id

Data.description_en: The default data classification template returned. The value is in JSON format
Data.description_zh: 返回的默认分类分级模板数据。JSON格式

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
